item_name: Rothco Super Warrior Vehicle Play Set
item_short_desc: Fuel your child’s imagination with Rothco’s Super Warrior Vehicle Play Set, a 10-piece toy collection designed to provide endless hours of fun. This classic play set includes everything your little one needs for action-packed adventures, featuring 3 action figures, 2 guns, a boat, a helicopter, a truck, and 2 life preservers. Crafted from durable plastic, these rugged toys are built to withstand countless play sessions, whether indoors or outdoors.
